deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: This setting controls whether destructive deletion of the resource is prevented. Because it can protect the resource from accidental or unauthorized destruction, it is a security-relevant lifecycle control.

ingress_policy_name.description: The name of the Service Perimeter to add this resource to.
ingress_policy_name.rationale: Names the Service Perimeter that this ingress policy attaches to; it is a reference to another resource (the perimeter), and platform policy does not constrain which named perimeter a team attaches to.

resource.description: A GCP resource that is inside of the service perimeter.
resource.rationale: This argument identifies the GCP resource governed by the ingress policy. Because ingress rules define which resources may be reached across the service perimeter, constraining the target resource is part of enforcing the access boundary.
